mei: Quick postmortem follow-up. We need a short, concrete delivery plan for rollout hardening: 1) automated quarantine tags on executions, 2) conservative flag defaults + approval gate, 3) canary audit that replays incident traces. Owners and ETAs?

ash: I'll own the quarantine tags + circuit-breaker token. Idea: when a rollout hits a safety alert, the controller marks the execution with `quarantine=true` and a `circuit_token` that prevents further cascaded rollouts until cleared. ETA 7 days. Will add tests.

devops-bot: Created tickets: <https://tracker/redwood/INF-8200|INF-8200> quarantine tags (ash); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-8201|INF-8201> flag-approval-gate (mei); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-8202|INF-8202> canary-audit-harness (sre-olga).

sre-olga: I'll build the canary audit harness that replays the sanitized incident workload and validates rollback order + timing. Plan: run in staging + a canary sim cluster. ETA 6 days. Need permission to seed the canary cluster; pinging @eng-infra.

mei: For flag policy I'm proposing an approval gate: any flag with `affects_inference=true` must be `default=false` and require a short approval ticket (2 approvers). I'll own the validator and the UI change in the flag console. ETA 4 days.

ash: Quarantine semantics I'm adding: `quarantine=true` flags execution, prevents new rollouts for that model for 30m, and requires manual clear or a successful verification run. We'll add a small reconcile test that flips the tag under simulated error.

paul: Can we have explicit metrics in each ticket? detection latency, quarantine propagation time, time-to-clear, and audit pass/fail rate. Also add a simple runbook snippet: how to force-clear a quarantine and how to pin traffic to last-stable.

sre-olga: Will attach a sanitized trace from the postmortem to INF-8202 and a short checklist: 1) replay trace, 2) verify circuit_token blocks new executions, 3) assert rollback <= 4m.

mei: I'll write the approval gate rules and a migration plan for existing flags (auto-flag as `needs_review` if `affects_inference` and `default=true`).

devops-bot: Reminder: weekly 15m check-in Fri 09:00 to update INF-8200..8202.

ash: Adding a short code snippet to INF-8200 for the tag format: `quarantine: {reason: "safety_trip", until: "2026-04-10T12:34:00Z", token: "abc123"}`.

mei: Owners, please add ETAs in the tracker by EOD tomorrow and include one verification run in staging. If infra access blocks you, ping me or @sre-olga. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
